definition.prompt: Design one square sticker sheet containing exactly sixteen separate stickers in a clean 4-by-4 grid. Use the uploaded character as the sole character, keeping the face, hairstyle, outfit and colors consistent. Give each cell a different everyday emotion or gesture: joy, surprise, thanks, encouragement, sleepiness, celebration, curiosity, agreement, apology, determination, greeting, laughter, relief, confusion, excitement and affection. Simple expressive cartoon drawing, white cutout borders, generous separation. Add one short Chinese caption per cell from this supplied list: 开心; 哇; 谢谢; 加油; 困了; 庆祝; 好奇; 好的; 抱歉; 坚持; 你好; 哈哈; 松口气; 疑惑; 激动; 抱抱. Avoid background scenes and overlapping stickers.

review.notes: Caption 松口气 was shortened to 松气; exact Chinese text acceptance failed.
